scenarios.actual: 22 recorded browser steps passed for this role (run 0928074429, last step 2026-09-28T07:45:53.545Z). On Overview, Directors & Officers > Add director or officer showed a Director or officer name combobox with the placeholder "Select a user or enter a name", Role, Appointed on, Add and Cancel, and no Linked user control; Add was disabled while the name was empty. Typing "Ravi" opened the People list with Ravi Menon and 'Use "Ravi" without linking a user'; selecting Ravi Menon filled the name and showed the User linked person icon, and Add saved the row linked to Ravi Menon. Selecting Priya Raman and typing over the name removed the icon. Typing "Helena Marsh" listed only 'Use "Helena Marsh" without linking a user' (no user of that name); choosing it saved an unlinked row. A typed name committed with Enter saved unlinked. On existing rows a typed name saved on leaving the field, selecting Amara Nwosu from People saved and linked, a date saved on blur and a Role choice saved at once. With the Entity archived by a second actor after the page loaded, a name change was refused (409, "This entity is archived.") and the row showed the saved name again. Resigned on before Appointed on was refused with "The resignation date cannot be before the appointment date."; Resigned on 2024-08-31 moved the Officer to Show former and clearing it brought it back. The linked user got no Grant. "Remove Ravi Menon" deleted that row only. Registrations: Add registration saved Jurisdiction, Registration number, Registered agent and Status Lapsed; the agent saved on blur and Withdrawn on selection; Formation jurisdiction stayed Republic of Aldoria; "Remove <jurisdiction> registration" deleted it and kept the linked Obligation without a Registration link. Ownership: "No share register yet"; Add Holding below Holdings in other Entities opened with Owner type Entity, Relationship Owns this Entity / This Entity owns, and Ownership percent 100. A 60% This Entity owns Holding showed on both Entities (Declared owners not in the register on the owned one); a second owner at 60% showed "Ownership totals 120% for ..." and saved; 30 on blur cleared it. An Individual with Full name saved with the label Individual and no Entity record. 150 was refused ("One or more request fields are invalid.") with the saved values kept; the picker did not offer the Entity itself or an existing Holding; a loop was refused with "This holding would create a loop: ...". "Remove <other party>" removed Holdings without deleting Entities. Documents: "No documents on this Entity yet.", no folders, and an Upload listed only on this Entity. Archive showed Archived and "This entity is archived. Restore it to edit.", removed the add controls, disabled New share class and Add Holding, and hid the Entity from the List and the Holding picker; List > Filter > Show archived found it, and Restore returned the controls with facts, Holdings, the Document and the Obligation intact.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough in headless Chromium (Playwright 1.63.0) by a different agent from the author and the source reviewer; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.
Author limitation confirmed on the lab: Helena Marsh is a seeded Officer name with no OpenLaw account (typing it lists no user), and typing "Ravi" lists the seeded user Ravi Menon.
The failed Officer save was produced by a second actor archiving the Entity through the API after the page loaded (a competing write); the Entity was restored in the same step.
The out-of-range Holding percentage refusal shows the generic "One or more request fields are invalid."; the guide quotes no message.
Adding an Officer role is covered by types-statuses-fields; this run used the seeded Director and Secretary roles.

In the final run, 3 page loads of an Entity record (1 for the Administrator, 2 for the Legal Team Member) showed the app's "Something went wrong." screen while many agents used the shared lab; the script reloaded and the page then loaded, and the step passed. No page error was logged and the cause was not established; the times and URLs are in walkthrough.json.
